about.description: Robinhood is a publicly listed (NASDAQ: HOOD) US retail brokerage founded in 2013 by Vlad Tenev (CEO) and Baiju Bhatt and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its tokenized-stock product launched June 2025, issuing 200+ EU-regulated 1:1 stock & ETF tokens on Arbitrum (eventually migrating to Robinhood's own L2). Tokens are MiFID II-compliant securities issued by Robinhood Europe UAB to qualified non-US users; settlement is on-chain and tokens accrue dividends and corporate actions automatically. Robinhood is the single largest tokenized-equity issuer on-chain by ticker count, with the biggest ticker breadth across any RWA platform.
about.registryInfo: Robinhood Markets, Inc. — Delaware C-corporation. NASDAQ-listed (ticker: HOOD; IPO July 29, 2021). Subsidiaries Robinhood Financial LLC (FINRA-registered broker-dealer) and Robinhood Crypto, LLC. Headquartered at 85 Willow Road, Menlo Park, CA 94025. Founded 2013. Co-founders Vlad Tenev (CEO) and Baiju Bhatt. Robinhood Stock Tokens are issued and minted on Arbitrum from the EU under MiFID II via Robinhood Europe UAB (Lithuanian-licensed investment firm).

fees.revenueNotes: Robinhood Markets generates revenue primarily from payment-for-order-flow (PFOF) on equities/options/crypto, transaction rebates from exchange counterparties, net interest income on cash/margin balances, Robinhood Gold subscription fees, and securities lending. Tokenized stock products (e.g. Robinhood-issued shares on Arbitrum) layer minimal mint/redeem fees on top of the existing brokerage P&L. Public company (NASDAQ: HOOD).
